entry_identity: P_m = P Hadamard (11^T + A diag(c_m) A^T), A_vq=a_q(v)
support: Exactly preserved for rho<1, including diagonal unless exempted.
rank: Latent score rank<=Q. Perturbation generally rank(P), already for Q1 with invertible D(a).
linear_mean_identity: mean_m P_m H W=P H W only for common H/W; real arithmetic.
different_inputs: mean P_m H_m = P mean H_m + mean Delta_m H_m; last term not generally zero.
normalization: Separate row or symmetric normalization generally breaks mean P. Bounds do not preserve degree or row sums. Symmetric GCN P itself need not be row stochastic.

cost.common_input: Q+1 width-F SpMM plus gate generation/diagonal multiplication/MQ mixing and member activations.
cost.different_inputs: After generic nonlinear divergence, M(Q+1) width-F equivalent SpMM; wide batching changes launch count but pays width M F. Proven special common-span or channel-commutation structure can retain reuse and must be stated.
cost.shared_W: Parameter storage shared; distinct member states still pay corresponding dense work.

constraints.sufficient_gate_bound: abs(a_q(v))<=1 via shared feature-generated tanh gates
constraints.one_common_scale: c_mq=rho b_mq / max(1, max_m sum_q abs(b_mq))
constraints.guarantees: sum_m c_mq=0 and every row L1<=rho in real arithmetic; no individual member renormalization.

initialization_caution: Identical differentiable members at c0 have identical coefficient gradients, killed by centering; gate derivatives also zero at c0. Distinct existing factors/dropout or fixed nonzero bounded centered c avoid relying on a dormant symmetric interface.
containing_single: One structured predictor with all four blocked trajectories and the identical mean-probability readout is pointwise the bank; no duplicate fit or ensemble-only capacity claim.
latent_metric: diag(c_m) can be indefinite; this is a signed bilinear score, not necessarily a PSD similarity.
